desc.en: This Xi’an Metro 2029 network map was drawn based on the current version from the gallery and @StudioMAX’s Bilibili video on the history of development. It includes additional stations on the planned Phase 4 Xihu Line, extensions of Line 3 (Yuhuazhai-Doumen South, Bonded Zone-Shuiliu), as well as Phase 1 of Lines 11, 12, 21, 17, and other lines. Thanks to @StudioMAX for supporting this project.
desc.zh-Hans: 根据画廊的现行版本和哔哩哔哩@StudioMAX的发展史视频绘制了这张西安地铁2029+线网图，包括4期规划中的西户线加站、3号线延伸(鱼化寨-斗门南)(保税区-水流)、11号线一期、12号线一期、21号线一期、17号线一期等线路。感谢@StudioMAX对本项目的支持。

updateHistory.reason: These revisions add the Phase 4 plan of the Xi'an Metro.
